title: RelayAgent user profile (roadmap P3-M1)
description: Local, explicit user memory at ${RELAY_PROFILE_ROOT:-~/.relayagent}/profile.yaml. Every section is an optional flat string→string map; the loader (agents/flow/user_profile.py) degrades a malformed section to empty with a warning.

contacts.description: Alias → who is meant (e.g. 老板 → 张三)

preferences.description: Stable tastes (e.g. milk_tea → 去冰三分糖). M3 proposals land here after an explicit y/n.

app_hints.description: app_id → free-text hint for that app's legs

last_choices.description: ask_user select_from memory (question key → chosen label); maintained automatically — records the user's own explicit pick
